set.body:
Scope
Combine shared/aligned row factors with block-specific observation families and structure while preserving direct-sum semantics.

Acceptance criteria
- Aligned shared-score GLRM, direct-sum studies, and hub-aligned studies remain distinct model families.
- Each block declares row alignment, observation mask, loss scaling, geometry, regularizers, and contribution normalization.
- Block size or variance cannot dominate silently; chosen weighting has a documented estimand.
- Block-local graph/TV penalties preserve block identities and adjoints.
- Fitted multiblock projection and latent encoding report block/global scores and contributions with provenance.
- Permuting blocks, relabeling features and graphs together, and duplicating a block satisfy declared metamorphic laws.
- Misaligned rows and incompatible block domains fail before numerical execution.
set.title: Multivar math 4: structured multiblock generalized low-rank programs
